reason: After Journey 9 no card has status Draft, yet J10.3, E.1, E.2 and E.4 need one.

changes.after: Before J10.3, E.1, E.2 and E.4, import a third package version so a Draft card exists.
changes.whyNeeded: Steps depend on a Draft card that no earlier step leaves behind.

checklist.Exact: fail: no fixture file and no import command are written; 'import a third package version' does not say what content or what expected output
checklist.Deterministic: fail: E.3 re-runs 'the Journey 8 command' (pkg-v2); once a third version is the latest that import reports new_version, not unchanged (server/lib/applicationPackages.js compares against the latest version), so the proposal makes E.3 order-dependent

review.note: Rejected as written. The gap is real, but this is a spec resubmission, not a product defect: nothing for the fix loop. A resubmission must (1) write the fixture (for example pkg-v3.json made by sed from pkg-v1.json with a different fictional summary sentence) and the exact import command with its expected output (resume_main #<new id> new_version, cover_letter #<id> unchanged); (2) take the next unused precondition id and state exactly where it runs (after J9.3, before J10.3); (3) change E.3 so its re-import uses the latest imported package file and still expects every output unchanged, or state E.3 runs before it; (4) say which card is the Draft the later steps use.
